name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
steps: Grip a pull-up bar slightly wider than shoulder width, engage your lats, and raise your straight legs up until your shins near the bar.
Lean your torso back under control so your legs point roughly upward while your shoulders stay active.
Sweep both legs together slowly down to one side in a wide arc, then pull them back up through center and over to the opposite side.
Continue alternating smoothly from side to side before lowering your legs back to a controlled hang.
tips: Control every sweep with your obliques and lats rather than swinging your legs with momentum.
Bend your knees slightly to shorten the lever if keeping straight legs causes your shoulders to collapse.
